summary: Oxyphenisatin Acetate was pulled from the market in the United States and 18 other countries, starting in 1970, due to liver harm [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a medium risk score of 58 for the liver and a low risk score of 27 for the heart [M]. Several similar drugs, including Oxyphenisatine, Triacetyldiphenolisatin, and Cyclofenil, were also withdrawn from various countries because of liver harm [3][4][5].
